equity.level_reason: Race/ethnicity results are reported by group in Table 1 and described, with no significant differences claimed. No contrast is quantified or framed as a disparity, so the level is 2.

level_alternative.reason: A stricter reader treats race as a sample descriptor and a null test result, since the text makes no group-specific claim beyond 'no significant differences'.

equity.equity_measurement: Race/ethnicity is self-reported; 'other' is too small for separate analysis (table note). The convenience sample means group percentages are not population estimates.

notes: Significance claims for sex, grade and race name no test, and the community-versus-school 'greater proportion' has no stated test. No CIs, weights or regression are reported. Descriptive percentages come from Table 1 counts.
view_issues: 822 minus 108 excluded is 714, yet '642' is 'of those' participants; the 72 gap (grades outside 7-12) is not explained in the text. Table 1 current female 43 (12%): 43/342 is 12.6%.
